title: Apni kismat azma kar dekhna
body:
Apni kismat azma kar dekhna
APNI QISMAT AAZMA KAR DEKHNA
TUM AZA KHANA SAJA KAR DEKHNA
KHUD MUNAFIQ KA PATA CHAL JAYEGA
<<DIVIDER>>
NARA-E-HAIDER(A.S) KAR LAGA KAR DEKHNA
HO AGAR JANNAT ZAMEEN PER DEKHNI
KARBALA EK BAAR JA KAR DEKHNA
ANBIYA KO DEKHNA CHAHO AGAR
<<DIVIDER>>
HALQA-E-MATAM MEIN AA KAR DEKHNA
TUM KO ZEHRA(A.S) KI DUA MIL JAYE GI
PARCHAM-E-GHAZI(A.S) UTHA KAR DEKHNA
WOH TAU PHIR MOLA ALI(A.S) HAIN HASHR MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
MARTABA QAMBER KA AA KAR DEKHNA
CHAND TAARAY DEKHNA CHAHO AGAR
DAAGH MATAM KE SAJA KAR DEKHNA
KHUSHBOO-E-ROOMAAL-E-ZEHRA(A.S) CHAHIYE
<<DIVIDER>>
ASHQ MAJLIS MEIN BAHA KAR DEKHNA
PANJETAN MEHMAAN KHUD HONGAY ZAKI
FARSH MAJLIS KA BICHA KAR DEKHNA
author: Mir Hassan Mir
